remaining_work: Semantic implementation review of remaining EC3 annotations, reply relationships and replacements
Conditional requirements, context-dependent enumerations and algorithms outside the explicitly listed native mechanisms
Complete PDF 2.0 semantic and rendering conformance
External accessibility and mathematical-content review for WTPDF, and content semantics that cannot be decided from object structure alone
catalogue_descriptions: New normative English source prose is explicitly labelled normative-source/en; the 53 existing authored summaries retain project-authored/en. Source paragraphs are distinct from reviewed correction overlays.

implemented_mechanisms.title: Complete edition-scoped dictionary inventory and selected EC3 provenance
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: 440 source tables classified; 306 dictionary definitions, 1704 fixed and 7 variable entry classes, 2324 generated PHP files and explicit immutable Catalogue; physical source clauses and grids, repaired continuations, case-sensitive names, finite name alternatives and reviewed EC3 overlays stay separate from native semantics.
limits: Complete dictionary inventory is not complete algorithmic, contextual, EC3 or document conformance.
Some source entries intentionally have any/various domains; private keys remain explicitly representable.

implemented_mechanisms.title: Header, catalog and effective incremental version
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: Explicit PDF20 enum/header and direct supported catalog version; effective version checks on current and frozen revision graphs; EC3 rule prevents an incremental update from lowering an already effective PDF 2.0 version.
limits: Writing a PDF20 header does not establish complete conformance.

implemented_mechanisms.title: Explicit Unicode text-string strategies and decoding
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: Application Unicode validation; default PDFDocEncoding/UTF16BE strategy preserves historical output while avoiding BOM collisions; explicit UTF16BE and UTF8 with BOM; decoding follows its explicit version context; typed UTF8 values require effective PDF20 in current and historical graphs.
limits: Font character codes in Tj/TJ remain a separate mechanism.
Raw LiteralString/HexadecimalString bytes are not reinterpreted as typed application text.

implemented_mechanisms.title: Associated files on actual PDF owners
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: Explicit standard or custom AFRelationship names; nonempty AF arrays and effective Filespec, EF/RF, indirectness, MIME and optional Params/ModDate constraints; actual Catalog/Page/StructElem/DPart/annotation/metadata/image/Type1Form contexts and incremental replacements.
limits: No implicit filesystem/URL loading, encrypted-wrapper orchestration or attachment viewer UI.
Private dictionary keys and earlier-edition AF extensions do not automatically acquire PDF20 semantics.

implemented_mechanisms.title: Named MCAF resources and native marked-content emission facts
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: Dictionary-valued Resources.Properties entries containing MCAF arrays, named AF BDC sequences, rejection of inline MCAF and single-point associations, per-page/per-form resource contexts and effective incremental replacements. Native association facts are frozen with the bytes emitted and retained across unstaged builder mutation and encoder callbacks.
limits: AF BDC uses an existing PDF operator; it adds no Annex A operator token.
Caller-declared opaque content bytes do not acquire invented native operator facts.

implemented_mechanisms.title: Independent resources for PDF20 Form XObjects
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: PDF20 Form XObjects declare their own resource dictionaries; MCAF resolution uses their actual effective resources, including indirect resource dictionaries and incremental replacement/removal. Earlier-version resource fallback retains its existing behavior.
limits: This validates resource ownership and native associations, not a rendering engine or interpretation of arbitrary opaque form bytes.

implemented_mechanisms.title: Bounded PDF date values in associated-file parameters
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: Explicit date-string decoding, bounded byte length, successive components, Gregorian calendar and clock/offset ranges; preserves supplied bytes and historical terminal-apostrophe syntax without timezone normalization.
limits: Date validation does not invent missing source modification metadata.

implemented_mechanisms.title: PDF20 encryption restrictions and CMS permission facts
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: Introduced/deprecated/prohibited feature status; historical R5 forbidden for PDF20; standard handler accessibility/reserved permission requirements and encrypted-catalog placement; document CMS requires explicit actual permission facts, most-significant-first order, accessibility bit10 and reserved bits13–32, with backend/decrypted-payload consistency checks. Existing permitted public-key ciphers retain explicit writer integration.
limits: Deprecated earlier algorithms are not silently treated as prohibited.
Explicit encryption and CMS verification do not establish PKI trust or authenticated content.

implemented_mechanisms.title: Explicit PDF2 namespaces and role graph validation
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: Immutable standard/custom namespaces, direct same-namespace and cross-namespace role mappings, cycle detection, standard-role resolution, namespace membership, structure references, namespace-owned attributes and effective/frozen PDF2 version gates; TS32005 inclusion is selected explicitly.
limits: Semantic tagging, reading-order adequacy and MathML grammar remain external/manual obligations.
Official TS32005 text and explicitly selected published issue resolutions remain distinct profiles.

implemented_mechanisms.title: Native document parts and effective hierarchy validation
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: Explicit DPartRoot, DPart, metadata and catalog/page entries; finite acyclic hierarchy, unique parents, reciprocal page range references, DFS ordering, record level and effective incremental graph checks. EC3 flat child references replace obsolete nested groups; XMP is prohibited on DPart and explicitly supported on DPartRoot; DPM permits valid UTF-8 name values. Raw incremental replacements execute the same conditions.
limits: Document-part metadata does not infer business record semantics.
The addGroup method is replaced by addChildren; DPartRoot named variadic argument nodeNames becomes entries. See resources/document-parts/README.md.

implemented_mechanisms.title: Unencrypted wrappers around explicit encrypted payload bytes
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: Explicit EP descriptors and indirect file specifications, associated payload ownership, named embedded payload identity with additional attachments permitted by EC3 #529, hidden collection and version constraints validated on the effective graph; wrapper encryption is rejected.
limits: Payload content remains opaque and its external security handler is supplied explicitly; no network retrieval or arbitrary payload decryption is inferred.

implemented_mechanisms.title: Native XMP metadata streams, locations and black-point state
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: Explicit immutable XMP packet/property objects and PDF metadata streams, strict XML syntax/domain validation, real catalog/object/resource and marked-content locations, versioned metadata owners, plus native black-point compensation graphics-state values.
limits: XMP declarations express caller claims and do not certify their truth.
The core emits graphics state; ICC colour conversion and visual rendering are external.

implemented_mechanisms.title: Native revision6 standard password security
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: Explicit password preparation and bounded iterative hash, owner/user authentication, permission blocks, AES256 CBC file cipher and native writer integration; revision7 AESGCM and PDFMAC are separately tracked ISO technical-specification extensions.
limits: Password encryption does not provide external identity trust.
Newer extension algorithms require their own declared extension level/revision.

implemented_mechanisms.title: Native RFC3161 timestamps and DSS/VRI revision relationships
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: Explicit timestamp requests/providers/verifiers, bounded DER and CMS signed attributes, message-imprint/nonce/policy/certificate binding, actual writer byte ranges, repeat timestamp revisions, DSS certificate/CRL/OCSP streams, VRI signature binding and permission-aware incremental ordering.
limits: Cryptographic token verification does not establish an external trust chain, revocation freshness or legal signature validity.
OCSP/CRL payloads are supplied validation data, not an automatic online PKI service.

implemented_mechanisms.title: Native geospatial coordinates, measurements, viewports and point clouds
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: Explicit geographic/projected coordinate systems, paired local/world points, normalized bounds, preferred units, affine PCSM calculation, viewport selection and typed point-cloud tuples, with effective page/Form/image/3D owner validation and frozen revision checks.
limits: WKT grammar, EPSG registry meaning, GIS projection conversion and correctness of surveyed coordinates require explicit external evidence.
Independent sample regions in the example do not claim to depict the same converted map.

implemented_mechanisms.title: Native structure destinations with explicit page fallbacks
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: Explicit view parameters, local structure identity and remote byte-string IDs; ordered bounded content traversal with first-page fallback, action SD and named-destination SD, effective graph and frozen navigation checks.
limits: Remote and embedded target files are supplied externally; their IDs are not fetched or implicitly trusted.
Native viewport adaptation requires a native PageObject; frozen generic pages can be resolved through the effective graph.

implemented_mechanisms.title: PDF2 standard-font metrics and effective descriptor validation
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: Require FirstChar/LastChar/Widths/FontDescriptor for PDF2 simple fonts, including the standard fourteen; verify ranges, cardinality, finite metrics, indirect descriptor contracts and native/raw/frozen resource owners. Type3 descriptor requirements retain their tagged-document context.
limits: Font-program outline/metric agreement, embedding rights and substitution availability need independent external evidence.
PDF2 base metrics do not establish WTPDF or other profile font conformance.

implemented_mechanisms.title: Executable source-defined intrinsic relations and selected EC3 corrections
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: 120 explicitly authored immutable intrinsic rules across 53 PDF2 source tables, inherited by generated derived schemas and executed by validate/serialization. Numeric and name domains, array cardinalities, stream filter/parameter positions, XRef subsection ordering/Size/W, function dimensions, calibrated/ICC colours, pattern/mesh values, image-mask/JPX/sample/decode relations, callout/leader/polygon geometry and choice options are executable. EC3#444 Path overrides Vertices; EC3#468 choice indices use explicit edition semantics. Approval reply chains are verified independently against original annotations. EC3 corrections additionally execute exponential domains, PDF2 embedded-file MIME restrictions, recursively direct extension/linearization dictionaries, signature ByteRange Metadata/AF prohibition, local tree key/value ordering, structure non-null members and mutually exclusive structure-parent entries. EC3 local array and numeric domains cover nonempty page trees, radio-button inner collections, FontWeight 1..1000, required developer-extension URLs and nonempty RichMediaContent Configurations; PV and Scripts are typed new dictionary entries.
limits: These 120 rules do not close every conditional requirement in 1711 entries, every payload algorithm, resource-dependent constraint or document-profile check.
Only EC3 corrections explicitly listed in reviewed-overrides.json and ec3-semantic-reviews.json have semantic review evidence.
ChoiceField preserves Pdf17 construction by default; Pdf20Ec3 construction is explicit and actual document version is validated.
RichMedia Scripts asset-tree membership and 3D/media runtime interpretation are not established by local schema constraints.

implemented_mechanisms.title: PDF2 annotation appearance requirement and native Form/state relationships
implemented_mechanisms.implemented_scope: Effective page annotation AP requirement, simultaneous zero-width/zero-height and Popup/Projection/Link exceptions, AP.N and named-state relationships, native Form stream types and geometry, including retained snapshot upgrades. Unmatched AS retains the explicit processor fallback. A Projection with either collapsed dimension forbids AP.
limits: These graph checks do not render interactions or supply a missing appearance.
The six reviewed EC3 corrections do not resolve all remaining source annotations.
